newsitem.title: USA: American Filtrona in deal to be sold.
newsitem.headline: American Filtrona in deal to be sold.

text.p: Fibers and plastics company American Filtrona Corp. said Friday it agreed to be purchased by WBT Holdings LLC for $174 million.
American Filtrona said, however, that terms of the acquisition include selling American Filtrona's bonded fibers business to Bunzl Plc, an international paper and plastics group.
WBT is a limited liability company owned by several trusts of the Walter Bunzl family. The sale to WBT would be for a per share cash price of $43.
American Filtrona, based in Richmond, Va., produces bonded fibers and plastic products. It said it retained Goldman Sachs & Co to advise it.
American Filtrona stock did not trade Friday. It closed Thursday at $41.75 a share on Nasdaq.
